cases.question: Run a quick eval of Omni AI on these 3 prompts and tell me the pass rate: 'Show me revenue by month', 'Top 10 customers by spend', 'How many orders were placed last week'.
cases.ground_truth: Three generate-query calls made in query-generation-only mode. Because no golden expected query JSON is provided, the agent infers expected query dimensions from each prompt, scores topic/fields/filters/sorts or limit where applicable, and reports a numeric pass rate. The eval is not scored solely on valid JSON, command success, or absence of errors.
expected_behavior: The agent uses omni ai generate-query for each prompt and avoids unnecessary query execution, either by using --run-query false or by otherwise returning generated query JSON without result rows
The agent infers reasonable expected dimensions from each prompt and scores each generated query across at least topic and fields, plus filters, sorts, or limit when those are implied by the prompt
The agent does not score solely on valid JSON, command success, or absence of errors
The agent reports a numeric pass rate or per-case dimension scores, not just a narrative description of what the AI returned

cases.question: Compare AI accuracy on the main model vs branch id '{{EVAL_BRANCH_ID}}' using these prompts: 'Monthly revenue trend', 'Top products by category'. Tell me if the branch is better or worse.
cases.ground_truth: Each prompt run twice — once against main, once against the branch. Results compared side-by-side with a clear delta and regression check.
expected_behavior: The agent produces one main result and one branch-specific result for each prompt, identifying the branch UUID from the task in the comparison
The agent explicitly checks for regressions — prompts that passed on main but fail on the branch — not just whether the overall score improved
The output includes a comparison table or structured delta showing the score difference per prompt or dimension
The agent judges main and branch against the same prompt-intent or golden criteria, not by treating extra filters, fill fields, or different result rows as inherently better

cases.question: I have a JSONL eval file at evals/cases.jsonl with 5 test cases. Run them all against the model and give me aggregate scores by dimension.
cases.ground_truth: All 5 cases run in a loop using generate-query, scored per dimension (topic, fields, filters, sorts), with aggregate pass rates reported.
expected_behavior: The agent runs all cases from the file, not just the first one
Scores are broken out by dimension (topic accuracy, field accuracy, filter accuracy, sorts accuracy) — not just an overall pass/fail
The agent reports aggregate pass rates across all cases per dimension

cases.question: Snapshot the current model state and run evals so my results are reproducible later.
cases.ground_truth: Model YAML exported and saved, then evals run. Output notes the snapshot was taken before running.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni models yaml-get to snapshot the model before running evals
The agent saves the snapshot with a filename that includes a date or version identifier
The agent validates the model with omni models validate before or alongside the snapshot
